4-Step Order & Production Process

01

Submit Artwork & Backing Specs

Send us your artwork, size, quantity, and preferred backing (Iron-On, Sew-On, or Velcro).

02

Digital Proof Review

We create and send a digital patch proof for your approval.

03

Physical Sample Confirmation

After approval, we produce a sample patch and share it with you for final confirmation.

04

Production & Direct Shipping

Once approved, we complete production and ship your order directly to your doorstep.
